items.quote: you have a few (or more) client conversations that just... stopped.
items.statement: There are client conversations that just stopped without a final decision.

items.quote: the truth is, these aren’t necessarily lost deals. More often, they’re cases of poor qualification or unclear follow-up strategy.
items.statement: These silent deals are often cases of poor qualification or unclear follow-up strategy.

items.quote: I put together a full training on this: How to re-qualify, re-engage and prevent deals from going cold in the first place.
items.statement: The author offers a training on re-qualifying and re-engaging clients.

items.quote: If not, you can always go back to re-reading old chats and hoping for a reply.
items.statement: Re-reading old chats is less effective than pursuing a follow-up strategy to re-engage clients.

items.quote: It’s on YouTube — and yes, it’s 7 short lessons. Roughly 15 minutes each.
items.statement: The training consists of 7 short lessons that can be managed over 7 days.

items.quote: Drop a “+” in the comments and I’ll send you the link to the full training.
items.statement: The author encourages engagement by asking readers to comment for the training link.

overview: A promotional LinkedIn post offering a training program to improve client engagement in real estate sales.
